name: vimean-baby
description: Vimean Baby - Mother & Baby E-Commerce Platform for Cambodia

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "api,admin" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.dev:all: npx --yes concurrently -n "api,admin,storefront" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:storefront"
scripts.dev:mobile: if [ -d mobile ]; then cd mobile && flutter run; else echo '⚠️ Mobile directory (mobile/) not initialized yet. Run Flutter in mobile/ when ready.'; fi
scripts.install: npm --prefix admin-frontend install && npm --prefix user-frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix admin-frontend run build && npm --prefix user-frontend run build
